_comment: Phase 11 tutor response templates. SCAFFOLDING ONLY: fixed sentence frames with {placeholders} that are filled exclusively with values read live from the recorded layers (Phase 6 claims, Phase 8 relationships/refusals, Phase 7 deferral record) at query time. No template contains anatomy, mechanism, criteria, dosage, or outcome statements. The educational-use guard is referenced by pointer and rendered verbatim from src/psychiatry/types.ts.

answer_anatomy.header: ANSWER — grounded in recorded atlas layers (local retrieval; no external model).
answer_anatomy.geometry_available: AVAILABLE geometry (3D selection and camera focus supported)
answer_anatomy.geometry_documented: DOCUMENTED only — catalog entry with no geometry (no 3D selection, no camera move)
answer_anatomy.claims_intro: Recorded claims ({claim_count} — statement + source + evidence per line):
answer_anatomy.gaps_intro: Recorded gaps (omitted topics, not silently absent):
answer_anatomy.action_available: 3D action: entity {structure_id} can be selected and focused through the existing selection/focus pipeline.
answer_anatomy.action_documented: 3D action: none — DOCUMENTED entries have no geometry; the cited detail card is shown instead, with no camera move.

answer_system.header: ANSWER — recorded named-system co-location only (local retrieval; no external model).
answer_system.system_line: Named system under study: {display_name} ({system_id}) — overall certainty {certainty}.
answer_system.members_intro: Recorded atlas members ({member_count} — anatomical co-location, correlation only):
answer_system.causation_pointer: Every member record carries the causation disclaimer verbatim; this list asserts co-location only — no functional membership and no condition association of any kind.
answer_system.action_note: 3D action: none for the list itself — each AVAILABLE member can be selected and focused individually through the existing selection/focus pipeline; DOCUMENTED members show the cited detail card with no camera move.

refusal_clinical.header: REFUSED — clinical-intent question routed through the Phase 8 guard (no clinical answer is synthesized).

refusal_topic.header: REFUSED — beyond the supportable layer (no answer is synthesized).

refusal_parcel.header: NOT REPRESENTED — parcel question hits the closed Phase 7 mapping gate (no parcel is rendered or mapped).
refusal_parcel.unblocks_intro: Recorded unblock conditions (what would change this):
refusal_parcel.action_note: 3D action: none — no parcel geometry exists in this atlas and no parcel is mapped onto anatomy.

unknown.header: UNKNOWN — the question resolves to nothing in the recorded layers (no answer is synthesized).

not_represented.header: NOT REPRESENTED — no indexed structure matches (nothing is generated to fill the gap).

no_llm_note: Local retrieval + fixed templates only. No external model is called; no model weights, keys, or remote endpoints exist in this tutor.
